# Immutable framing control

`framing_control.py` is the verbatim `sw/mathaccel/driver/framing.py` blob from
original experiment control `98be2be8e8b0fd9e1f600631fb54dae9638ce726`.
The differential fixture verifies its SHA-256 after newline normalization.
Keeping the source here makes the regression independent of checkout depth
and later commit-attribution rewrites; the historical experiment control and
reported measurements are unchanged.
